programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Flesh & Blood, Part 2

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Das Superhirn
programme.desc: Kirk und die Crew begegnen einer Rasse intelligenter Pflanzen und einem verrückten Wissenschaftler, der der Galaxis Frieden bringen will.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Die Piraten von Orion
programme.desc: Spock erkrankt an einer für Vulkanier tödlichen Krankheit. Die Enterprise trifft auf einen Frachter mit einer Ladung Medikamente, die das einzige Heilmittel sind, aber Orion-Piraten greifen das Schiff an. Kirk muss sie aufspüren, bevor es zu spät ist.

programme.desc: Auf einem fernen Wissenschaftsoffizierstraining hauchen Gesteinsbrocken Fantasien neues Leben ein. Tendi beginnt den ersten Tag ihres Wissenschaftsoffizierstrainings.

programme.title: Apollo-Soyouz: Appuntamento nello spazio
programme.desc: Il 17 luglio 1975 Apollo e Soyuz si unirono nello spazio, segnando la fine della corsa spaziale e un simbolo di cooperazione USA-URSS durante la Guerra Fredda. Questo documentario racconta la missione con testimonianze, archivi rari e animazioni 3D.

programme.title: U-455 Il Sottomarino Dimenticato
programme.desc: Nell’estate 2008, un sottomarino tedesco intatto viene scoperto al largo delle coste italiane a 120 metri. Seguendo l’archeologo Lorenzo del Veneziano, si svela la storia dell’U-455, protagonista delle battaglie navali dal Baltico al Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Il naufragio del Baron Gautsch
programme.desc: Il 13 agosto 1914 il Baron Gautsch solca le acque del mare Adriatico diretto a Trieste. È in ritardo e il capitano decide di tenersi più vicino alla costa così la rotta sarà più breve. È la decisione fatale...!

programme.title: The Perón Identity
programme.desc: Juan Domingo Perón, tre volte presidente argentino, nascose per tutta la vita le sue vere origini. Un'indagine storica svela il segreto che avrebbe potuto distruggerne l’ascesa politica.

programme.title: Trump: potere, politica, accuse
programme.desc: Un viaggio attraverso la vita politica di Donald Trump, come è salito al potere, è caduto in disgrazia e ha subito le conseguenze delle sue azioni criminali.

programme.title: La notte del conte rosso
programme.desc: 24 maggio 1941, il piroscafo Conte Rosso fu affondato da un sottomarino britannico al largo di Siracusa. Quella notte morirono in mare 1297 soldati. Fu uno dei più grandi disastri nella storia della Marina Militare Italiana.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Sono tante le leggende e i miti che circolano nell’universo parigino nel corso della sua storia. Ma non tutto ha una spiegazione. Molti misteri restano tali.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Per secoli la figura di Flamel, uno dei più famosi alchimisti del Medioevo, è stata oggetto di leggende. Molti ritengono che egli abbia scoperto il segreto della produzione dell'oro e dell'elisir di lunga vita.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Questa puntata prende in esame uno degli episodi più oscuri della storia di Parigi, il cosiddetto affare dei veleni, un periodo storico inquietante caratterizzato da morte, torture e messe nere, dove nessuno era al sicuro, nemmeno Luigi XIV.

programme.title: Versailles: ascesa e caduta Il sogno del Re Sole
programme.desc: Versailles, simbolo della gloria francese, fu teatro di tre regni reali dal 1643 al 1792. Questa serie in 3 episodi ricostruisce la vita, gli amori e il potere di Luigi XIV, XV e XVI, tra splendori e la caduta della monarchia Bourbon.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.sub-title: Cheope E La Tomba Dei Segreti
programme.desc: La piramide di Cheope, unica meraviglia antica ancora in piedi alta 146 m, affascina da 4500 anni. La fotogrammetria mostra la sua costruzione precisa senza tecnologia moderna.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.desc: Gli archeologi esplorano la piramide di Djoser a Saqqara, scoprendo un reticolato di gallerie sotterranee. Con Imhotep, architetto del faraone, e grazie alla fotogrammetria, trovano nuovi indizi sui metodi di costruzione antichi.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.sub-title: Meidum E Il Mistero Della Falsa Piramide
programme.desc: Nella valle del Nilo, a 80 km dal Cairo, si trova la piramide di Meidum, detta “falsa piramide”. Attribuita al faraone Snefru, è priva di firma. Grazie a fotogrammetria e studi, gli egittologi ricostruiscono la sua storia di 4500 anni fa.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: A cause des plaisanteries idiotes de Rapido, le lutin du Père Noël refuse de livrer le cadeau de Razmo.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Razmo est à bout : il vient encore une fois de laisser le dernier mot à Rapido. Il ne comprend pas pourquoi il ne trouve pas la force de lui répondre, alors qu’il sait pertinemment qu’il est plus intelligent que ce frimeur…

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Razmo a un accident spectaculaire avec sa rat-board et se rend compte que cet engin peut être dangereux.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.sub-title: Un ami qui vous veut du bien
programme.desc: Fred, un pingouin soi-disant "ami des stars", s’incruste sur le cargo.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Benny fait rentrer une poule à bord pour la cuisiner. Razmo ne peut rester insensible au sort de la pauvre bête et la délivre tant bien que mal.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Les rats découvrent un vieil appareil à raclette qu'ils astiquent avant de l’utiliser. Un génie en sort subitement et leur accorde trois vœux : un pour chacun et un vœu commun.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: En pleine mer, le cargo croise une embarcation sur laquelle un chien, Fred, fait du stop.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Pas vu pas pris
programme.desc: Oggy se prépare une boisson végétale. Mais dès qu'il a le dos tourné, les cafards mettent des trucs bizarres dans le mixeur. Oggy boit le mélange d'un trait. Et la potion a un résultat immédiat, mais inattendu : Oggy devient... INVISIBLE !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Dee Dee détective
programme.desc: Oggy a été cambriolé ! Déprimé, Oggy réagit bizarrement. Il fait comme si de rien n'était. Il fait semblant de regarder la télé, d'ouvrir le frigo... DeeDee part enquêter !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: La guerre du bouton
programme.desc: Un matin, Olivia se réveille avec un bouton sur le front. Argh ! Elle s'enferme dans sa maison et refuse d'en sortir. En surfant sur Internet, Oggy trouve une recette anti-acné à base de... cafards !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Les Cafards à la Poubelle
programme.desc: Oggy et Jack ont trouvé un nouveau travail : ils deviennent éboueurs ! Et ils partent vider les poubelles du quartier tôt le matin. Par chance, les cafards se trouvaient dans la première poubelle que nos chats ont ramassée.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Contrôle technique
programme.desc: Jack a transformé le garage d'Oggy en garage de mécanique automobile. Bob est leur premier client. Sa voiture a besoin d'être réparée et c'est Oggy le singe gris qui est de service. Problème : il ne connaît rien à la mécanique automobile.

programme.title: Foot De Rue: Alter Ego
programme.desc: Tag, Gabriel, Tarik, Eloïse et Nordine jouent avec passion au foot de rue. Ils décident d'en organiser la première Coupe du monde, en dépit des difficultés.

programme.title: Foot De Rue: Les enfants de la balle
programme.desc: Tag, Gabriel, Tarik, Eloïse et Nordine jouent avec passion au foot de rue. Ils décident d'en organiser la première Coupe du monde, en dépit des difficultés.

programme.title: Foot De Rue: Le 6ème Saï Saï
programme.desc: Tag, Gabriel, Tarik, Eloïse et Nordine jouent avec passion au foot de rue. Ils décident d'en organiser la première Coupe du monde, en dépit des difficultés.

programme.title: Foot De Rue: Un remplaçant qui dérange

programme.desc: Tag, Gabriel, Tarik, Eloïse et Nordine jouent avec passion au foot de rue. Ils décident d'en organiser la première Coupe du monde, en dépit des difficultés.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.sub-title: La Planète des Larmes de Cristal (Partie 2)
programme.desc: Le problème, c'est que pour construire ces escaliers, le roi rase toute la forêt. La déforestation provoque des invasions d'insectes incessantes, car ces derniers sont chassés de leur habitat.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Lorsque le Petit Prince revient sur la Planète des Vents, les éoluxes sont malades et les habitants sont sur le point d'attaquer les Nymphalidae (papillons géants) qu'ils soupçonnent d'être à l'origine du problème.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Le Petit Prince découvre que le Serpent a fait basculer la Planète des Vents contre la Planète des Nymphalidae (nouvelle planète).

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.sub-title: La Planète de l'Oiseau de Glace (Partie 1)
programme.desc: Le Petit Prince arrive sur la planète d'Ashkabaar. Shaaz et Zaak rêvent de marier leur fils, mais le jeune homme éconduit toutes les prétendantes...

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: A la suite d’une expérimentation ratée d’Etno, Bud reste figé comme de la pierre.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Etno s’est mis en tête de construire une super-antenne-galactique dans le but d’envoyer un SOS à Espace-assistance.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: C’est un beau matin de printemps, la nouvelle fusée d’Etno est prête à décoller. Mais un nouveau locataire débarque : c’est un collectionneur de jouets de science-fiction.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Candy, en faisant le ménage dans la cave, a découvert le journal intime d’une petite fille qui habitait jadis la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Candy a recueilli un têtard dans la mare de la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Une institutrice et ses élèves se sont installés dans la maison. Le crissement de sa craie sur le tableau noir est tellement insupportable que les Zinzins veulent s'en débarrasser au plus vite.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Etno entreprend de moderniser la maison, histoire de la rendre plus confortable.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Les aliens ne supportent plus de devoir se cacher pour échapper aux terriens, en l’occurrence cette fois toute une famille, les Adamski, qui vient de s’installer.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Les Zinzins sont harcelés à longueur de journée par un agent immobilier qui veut racheter la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un matin, Gorgious se réveille avec un bouton suspect sur le front.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Etno a terminé sa nouvelle fusée ! Cette fois-ci, la fusée décolle bel et bien ! Les Zinzins se dirigent vers l’espace, Candy au volant, lorsqu’un orage se déclenche.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: C’est le Jour J, les aliens rentrent enfin sur leur planète !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Pour compléter son encyclopédie sur les vitamines, Etno fait goûter à Candy un sirop qui a été oublié par le dernier locataire, un certain Dr Jekill…

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un vieil indien a installé son tipi dans le salon et son bison domestique broute les plantes vertes.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: On sonne à la porte. Pour une fois, c’est Bud, transformé en terrien, qui va ouvrir. Après s'être débarrassé du gêneur, Bud reste coincé en humain.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: La télé annonce la première expédition humaine dans l’espace lointain. Mais la capsule spatiale, qui heurte un météorite, retombe sur Terre et vient se planter dans le grenier des Zinzins !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Candy trouve un dessin d’enfant dans la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Les Zinzins en ont décidément assez de ces squatters de terriens. Etno a la solution : ils vont émigrer en mer !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Suite à un différent à propos de l’occupation des toilettes, Gorgious fait une crise d’autorité.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Island War
programme.desc: The Marines succeed in the "island hopping" strategy against suicidal resistance. The US Navy establishes supremacy, cutting off Japan.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Victory in Europe
programme.desc: In 1945, Germany is crumbly on both fronts. The Western Allies cross the Rhine and take most of Germany, while the Red Army quickly advances into Berlin. After Hitler's suicide, Germany surrenders and is divided among the allied powers.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Victory in the Pacific
programme.desc: Japan continues its suicidal resistance, and invading it looks costly. After 2 atomic bombs, the Emperor intervenes and stops the War. Stalin grabs territory in East Asia. The War is over, and the Atomic Era and the Cold War start.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Fler människor dödas 1944 än någonsin tidigare på Auschwitz. Nazisterna försöker skapa förvirring bland de allierade i öst, och de västallierade fattar beslut om att förhandla med nazisterna om judarna och bomba lägret.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: 1945 befriar Röda armén Auschwitz-Birkenau. När andra befrielseaktioner sker de följande månaderna, chockas världen. De överlevande judarna möter fasor när de försöker återvända till sina liv, och få SS-män hittas och ställs inför rätta.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Ryan y Kevin van a las salinas Bonneville a ver cómo el Turbinator, un vehículo con el récord de velocidad en tierra, intenta llegar al récord de 800 km/h. Davey pasa por el negocio a pedirle a Danny que lo ayude a vender un clásico Nash de 1951.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando un cliente llega a Count's Kustoms con un hermoso Chevy Nomad de 1955, Danny no puede evitar querer el auto para su colección.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny y Ryan tienen grandes planes para un Lincoln bajo. Lonnie, uno de los pintores con mucho tiempo en el negocio, quiere darle al Lincoln bajo una pintura nueva, pero simple, pero eso no sucederá.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando los muchachos de la Serie Mundial de Póker quieren un helicóptero de Count’s Kustoms como el obsequio más importante de Internet, Danny quiere hacer algo especial sin que parezca una valla publicitaria.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Le encargan a Danny hacer una pintura personalizada de una camioneta nueva para una subasta de caridad para el YMCA local, pero Danny no puede detenerse ahí y le agrega el mejor accesorio, un helicóptero haciendo juego.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Britain at Bay
programme.desc: Germany makes critical errors during the bombing of Britain.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Hitler Strikes East
programme.desc: The German invasion of Russia from Operation Barbarossa on 22 June 1941 to Kursk on 5 July 1943.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Pintando o Sete Com Gaspar
programme.desc: Passamos por Sumé na Paraíba. Depois visitamos Acari/RN conhecida como uma das cidades mais limpas do Brasil, fomos também em Santa Cruz/RN que tem a estátua de Santa Rita de Cássia, a maior imagem católica do planeta.

programme.title: Pintando o Sete Com Gaspar
programme.desc: Chegamos em Natal no Rio Grande do Norte. Fomos no encontro de fuscas e dos clássicos do Natal Fusca Clube. Gravamos no Beco da Lama. Conhecemos o Centro de Lançamento de foguetes, uma base da Força Aérea Brasileira.

programme.title: Expedição Nordeste
programme.desc: Os irmãos Caiã e Tauã Cordel se aventuram em Cururupu e Ilha dos Lençóis, ambos no Maranhão. Aventuras bem distintas marcam a passagem dos irmãos pelos municípios. As aventuras estão divididas entre uma pescaria e uma trilha nas dunas.

programme.title: Expedição Nordeste
programme.desc: As aventuras de Caiã e Tauã Cordel começam na histórica Guimarães, no Maranhão. Um passeio pela cidade e mais uma vez um envelope com as ações do dia. Dessa vez os dois tem que escolher entre uma trilha fechada e aventura no mangue.

programme.title: Fazendas Históricas

programme.title: Fazendas Históricas

programme.sub-title: Lig i lasten Speciel: Emil Thorup
programme.desc: Emil Thorup sætter sig ind i rustvognen til en samtale om liv, død – og alt det imellem. Han deler sin kamp mod hudkræft og sin passion for longevity. Med alvor og charme reflekterer han over sundhed, frygt og fremtidens store spørgsmål.

programme.title: Modig
programme.desc: Mellissa Hussein brød den sociale arv og søger i dag svar på, hvem der dræbte hendes lillebror. Vi taler om hendes opvækst på bl.a. Vesterbro og de svære emner, hun har mødt på vejen. En rørende og ærlig samtale.

programme.title: Naturligheder
programme.desc: En ny larve er kommet til Odense, og medierne frygter den. Larve-entusiast Sara Kande og fuglemand Gustav Urth fortæller om nye arter i Danmark, herunder en hidsig gås og mårhundens effekt på faunaen. Vi møder også en stille, nyere art.

programme.title: De Entreprenante
programme.desc: TV-kokken Louisa Lorang ser ikke sig selv som iværksætter, men med kogebøger, tv-programmer og stærke samarbejder er hun netop det. Hør hendes inspirerende rejse i De Entreprenante – fuld af vilje, drive og godt humør.

programme.title: Her er dit madliv

programme.desc: Eva deler historier fra sin tid som statist i italiensk film, sin kærlighed til det italienske køkken (og et par mænd) – og genopfrisker de pastaregler, som vi danskere ofte glemmer!

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus får besøg af kærlighedsduoen Nina Ettrup og Eva Lund, der deler om deres kærlighedsliv på tv, fremtidsdrømme og udfordringer ved at date med hele Danmark som dommer. Spørgsmål fra skålen giver ærlige og saftige snakke i Skål For Sandheden.

programme.title: Herreklubben
programme.desc: Hvad hvis vi droppede amerikanske varer? Blok og Alves undersøger, hvad vi kunne undvære – og hvad vi ville savne. Et sjovt og tankevækkende afsnit om afhængighed af USA og mulige alternativer. Husk at følge Herreklubben!

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 12 gæster Ralle Pikkefar og Martin Svensson Riis & Støiholm med historier om Cavling-prisen, Superliga-gossip, sorte penge og Robinson. Underholdning med masser af drengerøvsstemning!

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.sub-title: Hvad gjorde dig til - Season 1 - Episode 003
programme.desc: Lars har besøg af Ulrich Larsen, aka Muldvarpen. Hvordan fandt han mod til at rejse undercover til Nordkorea? Hvad lå bag beslutningen, og hvordan har det påvirket hans liv? En spændende samtale om mod og oplevelser.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 14 gæster Allan O og Dennis Cagara, tidligere professionelle fodboldspillere, studiet. Kendt for practical jokes, griner vi af historier om pis, lort, nøgenhed, kys og badekar mellem mænd, fascination af mænds vedhæng og meget mere.

programme.desc: Allan og Dennis taler med Per Wind – tidligere målmand og træner i FC København, som deler gode fodboldhistorier og kærlighed til sporten og solen.

programme.title: Naturligheder

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: En el sur de Chile, pequeños acontecimientos moldean la vida de los visitantes y trabajadores de un antiguo balneario termal. Las historias de los protagonistas se conectan en momentos de la vida cotidiana. Mientras los visitantes viven una pausa contemplativa, los habitantes del lugar están inmersos en su rutina. Tras largas horas de vacaciones en la naturaleza, dormir al sol, aprender a conducir, limpiar la casa, besar por primera vez, nadar de noche o simplemente caminar y conversar, el día se despliega lentamente en impresiones de felicidad y descubrimiento.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: La amistad de dos mujeres es puesta a prueba cuando una de ellas es diagnosticada con cáncer, mientras la otra enfrenta su propio embarazo.

programme.title: Campo a través. Mugaritz, intuyendo un camino
programme.desc: Un documental filosófico y etológico sobre Mugaritz. La mejor manera para definir y evaluar lo que ocurre en el espacio que gobierna Andoni Luis Aduriz es, según La Fura dels Baus, una mirada etológica sobre el comportamiento de ese grupo de humanos que habita el caserío Otzazulueta, en la frontera entre Astigarraga y Errentería.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica de armas descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo (y cosas como acostarse con la hija de su nueva esposa) han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Carmesí
programme.desc: Nora, una reconocida actriz, está en un bar con Lucía, su mejor amiga, cuando un joven se acerca a ella para intentar conquistarla. Sin embargo, Nora guarda un oscuro secreto en lo más profundo de su mente.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Rachel es una mujer moderna e inteligente cuya prioridad es su carrera diplomática en la Embajada Americana, lo que le obliga a estar viajando continuamente. Tras su fiesta de despedida en Ciudad de Mexico y a punto de trasladarse a Londres, despierta aun bajo los efectos del alcohol, en el apartamento de Alejandro , un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras Mujeres
programme.desc: En una boda en un hotel de Nueva York, un hombre y una mujer de unos cuarenta años se conocen y entablan una ingeniosa conversación llena de dobles sentidos. Ella fuma continuamente y él bebe sin cesar, mientras ambos despliegan sus estrategias para acercarse. Ella, con su acento británico y su habilidad para mantener a los hombres a distancia, atrae su atención con sus ocurrencias. Él, por su parte, utiliza múltiples tácticas para asediarla, resultando finalmente irresistible.

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Un Puñado de Polvo
programme.desc: Tras siete años de matrimonio, Lady Brenda, hastiada de su vida en la mansión Hetton, que es el orgullo y la alegría de su marido, entabla relación con un solicitado joven londinense. Lo que empezó siendo una simple vía de escape, está a punto de derrumbar los pilares de su tradicional modo de vida. Adaptación de "A Handful of Dust", de Evelyn Waugh, un retrato de la alta sociedad inglesa del periodo de entreguerras que muestra el carácter artificioso y frío de unas relaciones sociales no exentas de cinismo y crueldad.

programme.desc: In 1957, nine-year-old Peter Boland was on holiday having the time of his life on a remote farm in New Zealand when he simply vanished without a trace. Peter’s older brother Gavin Boland, a self-confessed sceptic, turns to Sensing Murder’s psychics.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Blood Money
programme.desc: Psychics Kelvin Cruickshank (NZ) and Deb Webber (Aus) investigate the unsolved murder of Lower Hutt pensioner 91 year old George Engelbrecht. In 1979, a burglar broke into George's home and beat the old man to death in his bed.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Long Way Home
programme.desc: 25-year-old Te Puke woman Judy Yorke was a devoted single mum who adored her kids. When she missed her daughter’s fourth birthday party, her family knew something was terribly wrong and reported her missing.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken for a Ride
programme.desc: 54 year old Simon Buis was savagely beaten and kicked to death in an Auckland park in 1980 by persons unknown. To this day, his killers have evaded capture.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: In 2006, 19-year-old Blake Stott died in a mysterious car fire. Blake had seemingly pulled into a South Otago lay-by to have a sleep, when his late-model, un-modified car burst into flames.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of 53-year-old, Cynthia Greenwood-Smith, to unravel the lies and discover the grim truth surrounding her disappearance from her Gold Coast home in 2001.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken Out
programme.desc: Was Donovan Reidy deliberately run down and left to die? In 1995, 23-year-old Donovan Reidy was at a party when he got into a fight. A short while later, his bloodied body was found on the side of a major New Zealand highway.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le test
programme.desc: Pour aider Hélène à faire son choix entre Nicolas et José, Cathy et Johanna lui proposent de se soumettre à un test. Elle doit dîner avec ses deux prétendants en présence des autres garçons.

programme.title: David Nolande
programme.desc: Sa femme, son médecin et ses amis parlent de traumatisme, mais David Nolande sait qu’il est maudit : pour chaque vie qu’il ne sauvera pas, un proche mourra. Son nouveau cauchemar annonce la mort imminente d’un nouveau-né.

programme.title: David Nolande
programme.desc: Isolé et incompris par sa femme, David renonce à suivre ses prémonitions, jusqu’à ce qu’un proche en paie le prix. Quand une nouvelle vision surgit, il quitte sa famille pour sauver un inconnu, aidé par Sauveur Christini.

programme.title: David Nolande
programme.desc: Hanté par un nouveau cauchemar lié à un milieu artistique fermé, David inquiète Corinne, persuadée qu’il sombre. En voulant le faire soigner, elle aggrave la situation et expose sa famille à un danger plus grand.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Le goût du risque
programme.desc: Todd, un vieil ami de Callaway, se tue lors d'un saut en parachute. Le policier décide d'enquêter pour son compte, en s'immisçant dans un groupe de sportifs de l'extrême, qu'il soupçonne être à l'origine de cet accident…

programme.title: France Kbek
programme.desc: Le comptable de l’entreprise charge Audrey de licencier Michaël qui a de mauvais résultats. Mais Michaël utilise son physique et son charme comme un pouvoir magique sur les femmes...

programme.title: France Kbek
programme.desc: Comme Christophe s’ennuie, Louis lui propose de l’emmener au Bilencio, la dernière boîte à la mode. Audrey décide de les suivre, plutôt que de fêter l’anniversaire de Mélanie...

programme.title: France Kbek
programme.desc: Jour de neige à Paris. Christophe téléphone à tous ses employés : pas de bureau aujourd’hui. Mélanie devient nostalgique et se replonge dans ses souvenirs...

programme.title: Doc Martin
programme.desc: Réveillé de mauvaise humeur, Martin enchaîne les tracas : les Groslay, Clémentine, Antoine et Marie-Jo. Peu sensible à l’agitation de Port-Garrec avant l’arrivée des touristes, il affronte une journée déjà bien chargée.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators And Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, Investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.desc: A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage, and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree with his character.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Nascem dois sóis em Tóquio, mais uma operação maléfica em movimento pelo Império Crisis.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Bancos são roubados e uma única prova do crime intriga a polícia: cascos de bananas. Issamu e Joe Kazumi levam o caso a sério e tentam bolar um plano para atrair alguém aficcionado por bananas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: Entre o Amor e a Amizade
programme.desc: Mais fugitivos do grupo de Resistência do Império Crisis caminham rumo à Terra. Desta vem quem aparece diante de Issamu e Joe é Célia, antiga namorada de Joe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Passos inquietantes ecoam no deserto da morte. A Shadow Moon, o inimigo mais poderoso e imortal de todos, voltou. Shadow Moon faz um pacto obscuro com o General Jark.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Masao presencia um acidente envolvendo soldados do Império Crisis e eles deixam cair um controle remoto em formato de teclado que possui habilidades ocultas. Pessoas começam a ter a aparência modificada uma atrás da outra e Issamu estuda o caso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: O pai de Hakyo continua agindo de forma estranha... O plano de Gadorian para alimentar a Comunidade Camila, transformando-os em comida para monstros, que envolve o Monstro Kaima Lickpack, ativa a ira de Issamu.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Maribaron volta para Crisis e recebe ordens expressas do Imperador Crisis. Bosgan recebe ordens específicas para capturar noivas cujo signo é de Escorpião. Bosgan chama o Guerreiro Kaima Gainakamakil e ambos vão ao encontro de Issamu para confrontá-lo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Bosgan, depois te perder para Robo Rider, volta com um trunfo em suas mãos: ele recebe uma nova espada chamada "Espada Kaima".

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: O Grande Contra-Ataque! O Retorno do Príncipe das Sombras!
programme.desc: Os planos de Crisis começam, de repente, a dar errado. A causa disso era que Shadow Moon estava preparando uma armadilha para atrair RX, interropendo as ordens do Monstro Kaima Mattbott que recebera de Gadorian.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: Os Representantes de Sua Majestade, O Imperador
programme.desc: Inúmeras borboletas atacam as pessoas. Elas são basicamente soldados de Crisis enviados do Mundo Kaima pelo Monstro Kaima Gimeragomera, responsável por criá-los.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.desc: Dokusai recruta Kenin Parchis, o mestre dos disfarces, justamente quando Tetsuzan está no exterior participando de um torneio. Logo depois um ganancioso corretor de imóveis contacta o dojo Togakure.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.desc: A Família de Feiticeiros vai ao oeste americano e põe a cabeça de Jiraiya a prêmio. O ninja pistoleiro Rainin Wild sai em busca dessa recompensa.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 21 - A Ira da Lua Seinin Allan
programme.desc: Os carros e postos de gasolina da cidade estão tendo seus tanques esvaziados por um estranho dardo chamado Ira da Lua. O responsável é Seinin Alan, um ninja sagrado, protetor da natureza, que está sendo enganado pela Família dos Feiticeiros.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 22 - A Dimensão da Amizade Kenin Parchis Kei(Himenin Emiha)
programme.desc: Kei salva uma menina das valentonas da rua e assim faz uma nova amiga. A Família de Feiticeiros percebe uma chance de atingir Kei e planeja uma emboscada.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 23 - O Sequestro dos Cientistas Tetsunin Steel (Tetsunin Gamesshu) Dr. Smith
programme.desc: Os Tetsunin são uma terrível organização criminosa que planeja sequestrar Dr. Smith com a ajuda de Dokusai. Tetsunin Steel é o perigoso ninja metálico que lidera esta organização

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 24 - O Capitão Pirata Suinin Tubarão Mor Tōha(Jiraiya), Rei Yagyū(Kinin Reiha) e Ryū Asuka(Yanin Spiker)
programme.desc: Toha, seus irmãos e Ryu desconfiam que os Feiticeiros estão planejando algo em um resort próximo. Logo descobrem um tesouro submarino e são atacados por Suinin Tubarão-mór

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 25 - O Rapto dos Animais Jūnin Makunba e seu irmão mais velho Manabu e Kaio Tsumoto
programme.desc: Ninguém sabe o que acontece. Os animais de estimação do bairro inteiro estão desaparecendo. O responsável é ninguém menos que Makunba, o ninja caçador. Mas ele não havia sido derrotado?

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 26 - A Primavera de Emiha Nukenin Kei(Himenin Emiha), Kaminin Oruha e Shin Yazaka
programme.desc: O homem que esconde o segredo de uma antiga ruína: Shintarou Yasaka. Procurando seu paradeiro Jiraya e os demais são atacados pelos Yonma. Durante a batalha, Kei é envenenada e para salvá-la, chega o pesquisador Shintarou.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 27 - Jiraiya, o inimigo de Toha (Nenhum) Tōha(Jiraiya) e Yajirō Iyo
programme.desc: Diante de Touha, surge um novo inimigo e seu nome, estranhamente, é Jiraiya. Qual a verdadeira identidade dele? Qual o segredo escondido por trás disso? Vestindo a Jiraiya Suit ele avança sobre o indefeso Touha. Touha terá chance de vencê-lo?

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: The family have been squatting at Leopard's Den as they prepare to make their last stand to prevent the bulldozers from destroying their home. Du Plessis and Fatani bring elephants and a giraffe to dissuade the construction crew from moving in.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: After the devastating loss of Leopard's Den, the family are split across continents. Caroline, Liv and a heavily pregnant Alice are in the UK, while Danny and Du Plessis have remained in South Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny returns to South Africa with Caroline, Liv and Charlotte. They are all excited to be back and are looking forward to seeing their new home, Clearwater Farm.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny has been preparing his pitch for an Endangered Species Project. JLW, a pharmaceutical company, are looking to fund an environmental project and the family hope that this grant money will enable them to buy Leopard's Den and Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Ed release two cheetah brothers together, a symbol of their new partnership, but not all of the family are happy about this new start. Caroline is still furious at what she sees as Danny's betrayal of Du Plessis.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Ed are anxiously preparing for a review with JLW, the pharmaceutical company that fund their Endangered Species Project. They are desperate for it to go smoothly, and as a result are driving the rest of the family mad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!
